concepts.name: Law of Reflection
concepts.real_life_application: Seeing your own reflection in a mirror

problems.question: A ray of light strikes a plane mirror at an angle of 30°. What is the angle of the reflected ray?
solution: According to the law of reflection, the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.
Therefore the reflected angle is also 30°.

ex2.title: Refraction Problem
ex2.objective: Use Snell's law to find refraction angle

problems.question: A light ray passes from air (n=1.00) into water (n=1.33) with an incidence angle of 45°. Find the refraction angle.
solution: Snell's law: n₁ sinθ₁ = n₂ sinθ₂.
Thus the refracted ray makes an angle of about 32° with the normal.
